title: The Snow Patrol Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "snow patrol". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: In which Scottish city was Snow Patrol originally formed?
questions.answerNote: Snow Patrol formed in Dundee in 1994 while its members were at university there.

questions.prompt: Who is the lead singer of Snow Patrol?
questions.answerNote: Gary Lightbody has fronted Snow Patrol since its formation.

questions.prompt: Which Snow Patrol song opens with the line "If I lay here, if I just lay here"?
questions.answerNote: That line opens Chasing Cars, one of the most played songs on UK radio ever.

questions.prompt: "Chasing Cars" appears on which Snow Patrol album?
questions.answerNote: Eyes Open, released in 2006, was the album that made Snow Patrol massive.

questions.prompt: Which 2003 album was Snow Patrol's commercial breakthrough?
questions.answerNote: Final Straw, released in 2003, turned Snow Patrol into a chart-topping act.

questions.prompt: Snow Patrol's album "Eyes Open" reached which position on the UK album chart?
questions.answerNote: Eyes Open went straight to number one on the UK albums chart in 2006.

questions.prompt: Which Snow Patrol member later co-wrote hits for Ed Sheeran and One Direction?
questions.answerNote: Johnny McDaid, who joined Snow Patrol on keyboards, is also an in-demand co-writer for other pop stars.

questions.prompt: Gary Lightbody was born in which Northern Irish town?
questions.answerNote: Gary Lightbody grew up in Bangor, County Down.

questions.prompt: Snow Patrol's song "Set the Fire to the Third Bar" is a duet with which singer?
questions.answerNote: Canadian singer Martha Wainwright duets with Gary Lightbody on that Eyes Open track.

questions.prompt: Which side project, featuring R.E.M.'s Peter Buck, did Gary Lightbody form in 2010?
questions.answerNote: Tired Pony released their debut album, Tired Pony: The Place We Ran From, in 2010.
